Auto svg conversion with accessible names disabled

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:h2m/h2m.dart';
import 'package:h2m/src/html_to_markdown_rs_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final options = await createConversionOptionsFromJson(json: '{"inline_data_media":"AltTextOnly","tier_strategy":"Auto"}');
    final result = await H2mBridge.convertWithAccessibleNames('<p><svg aria-label="Name"><text>Drawn</text></svg></p>', false, options: options);
    stdout.writeln(result.content);

    RustLib.dispose();
```
